content:
On behalf of the moderation team, let me announce that there is now a way to reach the moderation team, via Zulip: writing a direct message to @leanprover-community mod bot starting with to-mods will send that message to the moderators' stream.

This applies in particular if a moderator suspends or bans someone and you think it was unjustified: complaints about bans in-channel are discouraged; writing to a moderator individually may not be answered. Instead, please use the above method to contact the team.
